newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTANI RUPEE ENDS STEADY IN KERB, SEEN STABLE.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTANI RUPEE ENDS STEADY IN KERB, SEEN STABLE.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 41.30 to the dollar in the kerb market on Friday on balanced demand and supply of the U.S. currency and dealers said it was likely to open stable on Saturday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rupee rate, last changed on July 11, was 40.5200/40.7226 against the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.00 percent compared to the opening at 2.10 percent.
